kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نسلنطع (form IIIq)
# نَسْلَنْطِعُ (naslanṭiʕu) /nas.lan.tˤi.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْلَنْطَعَ (islanṭaʕa)
# نَسْلَنْطِعَ (naslanṭiʕa) /nas.lan.tˤi.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْلَنْطَعَ (islanṭaʕa)
# نَسْلَنْطِعْ (naslanṭiʕ) /nas.lan.tˤiʕ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْلَنْطَعَ (islanṭaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
